title: DESIGN-LAB Adobe host capability matrix (DL-P0-070)
description: Claimed versus recorded host capability. A declared API is never a verified API; absent hosts carry no verification; editable delivery requires a declared delivery API and an explicit readback method.

inventory_ref.description: Repository-relative path of the recorded machine inventory this matrix reads.

inventory_observed_at.description: Observation date carried by the recorded inventory; not a test timestamp.

evidence_level.description: Whole-document level. This matrix is E1 STRUCTURAL by construction.

inventory_name.description: Exact name as recorded in the machine inventory, for cross-checking.

install_alias.description: Alias key only; never an absolute user path.

present.description: PRESENT in the recorded inventory. Absence means NOT_FOUND_IN_SCOPE, never proof of universal absence.

declared.description: The project claims this surface exists for this host version.

verified.description: True only when live evidence exists in this repository for this exact host version.

readback_method.description: How an editable result is read back, or null when no editable delivery is claimed.

evidence_refs.description: Repository-relative references for the facts asserted in this entry.

by.description: Who verified. Use an explicit 'nobody'/'not-recorded' marker rather than an empty string when the state is not live.

at.description: When. Null when nothing was verified; an observation date is not a verification date.
